meta_description: SJP Decorating Services in Sheffield delivers expert interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes, reliable service.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior decorating. Free quotes, no pressure, hassle-free service across Sheffield.
services_subhead: From fresh interior walls to full external refurbishment, we handle every decorating job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh any room with expert wall and ceiling painting, feature walls, and colour consultation. We protect your furniture and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof your property with quality exterior paint and render work. Prolongs the life of your building and boosts kerb appeal.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation or removal. We prepare surfaces properly so patterns align and edges stay crisp.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting, architrave, and window frames painted to a high finish. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for a professional result.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Matt, satin, gloss, and textured finishes for every surface. We advise on durability and appearance for kitchens, bathrooms, and high-traffic areas.

services.title: Domestic & Commercial Work
services.desc: From single-room updates to whole-property refurbishment and small commercial spaces. Flexible scheduling to suit your needs.

about_pullquote: Good decorating is about doing it right once and lasting years.
about_para_1: SJP Decorating Services was established in 2009 with a simple aim: deliver expert painting and decorating work at a fair price, with no cutting corners. Based in Aston, Sheffield, we've built our reputation on reliability, attention to detail, and treating every home as if it were our own. Over 15 years, we've completed thousands of projects across Sheffield and surrounding areas.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, prepare surfaces properly, use quality materials, and tidy up completely. We don't rush jobs or oversell unnecessary work. Whether you need a single room refreshed or a full property renovation, we'll give you an honest quote and deliver the finish you expect.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About SJP Decorating

reviews.text: Excellent job redecorating our front room. Steve was tidy, professional, and finished on schedule. Really pleased with the quality—the paintwork is immaculate. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our hallway and stairs done. Steve moved furniture carefully and protected everything. The prep work was thorough—no rushed corners. Looks brilliant and he left the place spotless. Will definitely have him back for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Linda M.

reviews.text: Got a free quote within two days. Very honest—didn't try to upsell anything. The external painting transformed our cottage. Great value, professional throughout. Best tradesman I've dealt with in years.
reviews.author: Robert K.
